scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @spil/shared && (npm run dev --workspace @spil/server & npm run dev --workspace @spil/client)
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @spil/shared && npm run build --workspace @spil/server && npm run build --workspace @spil/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @spil/shared && tsc -p server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p client/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @spil/shared && npm run test --workspace @spil/server && npm run test --workspace @spil/client
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build --workspace @spil/shared && npm run build --workspace @spil/client && npm run test:e2e --workspace @spil/client
